usage: sot-validator run [-h] [--snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                         [--html-dashboard] [--html-output HTML_OUTPUT]
                         [--site-ids SITE_IDS [SITE_IDS ...]] [--all-sites]
                         [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE] [--rate-limit RATE_LIMIT] [--no-resume]
                         [--fixtures] [--num-sites NUM_SITES] [--fixture-path FIXTURE_PATH]
                         [--sql-dump SQL_DUMP] [--sqlite-path SQLITE_PATH] [--csv-dir CSV_DIR]
                         [--json-export JSON_EXPORT] [--scrape-url SCRAPE_URL]
                         [--vcenter-json VCENTER_JSON] [--snmp-fixture SNMP_FIXTURE]
                         [--ad-json AD_JSON] [--dns-json DNS_JSON] [--dhcp-json DHCP_JSON]
                         [--active-within-days ACTIVE_WITHIN_DAYS]
                         [--stale-after-days STALE_AFTER_DAYS] [--evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME]
                         [--include-ips | --no-include-ips]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR
                        Directory for extracted site snapshots (defaults to <output-
                        dir>/snapshots).
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Directory to write all validation reports and dry-run action plan
                        (default: ./output).
  --html-dashboard      Also generate self-contained interactive HTML5 dashboard
                        (validation_dashboard.html).
  --html-output HTML_OUTPUT
                        Optional custom output path for the HTML5 dashboard.
  --site-ids SITE_IDS [SITE_IDS ...]
                        Target site IDs (comma-separated or space-separated, e.g.
                        site-001,site-002).
  --all-sites           Process all available sites.
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
                        Number of sites per extraction batch (default: 10).
  --rate-limit RATE_LIMIT
                        Polite delay in seconds between per-site requests (default: 0.0).
  --no-resume           Disable checkpoint resume and re-extract all target sites.
  --fixtures            Use deterministic built-in FixtureSoTClient inventory.
  --num-sites NUM_SITES
                        Number of fixture sites to generate when --fixtures is set (default: 3).
  --fixture-path FIXTURE_PATH
                        Path to a JSON fixture file for FixtureSoTClient.
  --sql-dump SQL_DUMP   Path to a read-only SQL dump file (.sql).
  --sqlite-path SQLITE_PATH
                        Path to a read-only SQLite database export.
  --csv-dir CSV_DIR     Path to a directory containing SoT CSV export tables.
  --json-export JSON_EXPORT
                        Path to a JSON export file of SoT tables or sites.
  --scrape-url SCRAPE_URL
                        Base URL for read-only GET HTML scraping of the legacy SoT.
  --vcenter-json VCENTER_JSON
                        Path to a multi-vCenter inventory JSON snapshot.
  --snmp-fixture SNMP_FIXTURE
                        Path to a read-only SNMP/ICMP discovery fixture JSON file.
  --ad-json AD_JSON     Path to an Active Directory computer account export JSON file.
  --dns-json DNS_JSON   Path to a DNS forward/reverse (A/PTR) records JSON file.
  --dhcp-json DHCP_JSON
                        Path to a /24-scoped DHCP lease export JSON file.
  --active-within-days ACTIVE_WITHIN_DAYS
                        Threshold in days within which signals are considered active (default:
                        7.0).
  --stale-after-days STALE_AFTER_DAYS
                        Threshold in days beyond which inactive signals are considered stale
                        (default: 30.0).
  --evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME
                        Reference ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for signal recency evaluation.
  --include-ips, --no-include-ips
                        Include IPAddress records in site validation results (default: True).
